selection_basis: First broad Qwen discovery benchmark, before inspecting revised-model validation outcomes
chosen_workload: Source-grounded structured text: extraction, intent classification, fact lookup, and explicit policy decisions
excluded_workload: Arithmetic aggregation, probability, constraint optimization, unconstrained writing, and code generation
caution: Classification, lookup and policy are adjacent hypotheses to extraction, validated here rather than proven by the first discovery run. Router policy and generator portfolio were also revised during development; do not attribute all improvement to workload selection.
